notes.title: Ukrainian Game Festival 2023
notes.content:
[b][h1]Dear players! [/h1][/b]

We are glad to announce that Machi: Above Void will be taking part in the Ukrainian Game Festival! This is the largest Ukrainian game festival, which will be held from August 18 to 24.

The festival will feature hundreds of new games from developers from Ukraine. You will be able to get acquainted with new games, both from our studio and from other Ukrainian studios, you will find pleasant discounts and immersion in the world of Ukrainian game development. 

[h2][b]We are excited to announce that we are working on a new update for MATCHES! This update will include many new features including:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved and expanded music: The game now mixes up the music playlist.
[*] Multiplayer Guide: We've added a new guide to help you learn all about multiplayer in MATCHES. In this guide you will find information on how to create a game, join the game and play with friends.
[*] More levels: We've added many new levels to the game, each offering a unique gameplay experience.
[*] More building variations: We've added many new building variations to the game, allowing you to create even more unique and interesting levels.
[*] New non-square levels: The game now has levels that are not square in shape (3x4,4x5, etc.). 
[*] Replaced some sounds: We have replaced some sounds in the game with new, better and more pleasant ones.
[/list]
[h3][b]
Also a free demo version will be available soon.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The update is already here!
notes.content:
[h2]Now there is no default timer in Machi! We understand that every player has their own unique game strategy, so you can now choose whether to turn on the timer or play in relaxed mode. Solve puzzles in your own way![/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]We've also added Multichoice. It will make your game much easier by giving you options to fill each cell. Now you can see the possible choices and choose the most suitable one.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193644/0e124b6543a0dc4c6ea93daebeb311c6bf15f212.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Multichoice Picker feature. Incorrect move choices will now be highlighted in red.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193644/8d27842a42a9cc4d219c3fa200b00d7ba3a1edca.gif[/img]

[*][b]We redesigned the algorithms for solving puzzles, now each puzzle will have only one version of its solution.[/b]

[*] [b]We've also changed the difficulty system in MACHI. The level of difficulty will now depend on the number of hints provided in advance. The fewer hints you use, the more difficult the puzzle becomes. [/b]

[*] [b]We've also fixed some bugs we found at certain levels. We are pleased to announce that we have released a hotfix and the levels are now displayed correctly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your patience.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: The journey begins!
notes.content:
We are glad to present you our new game! Share your opinion about her! Write on the forum if you find any errors or figure out how to improve the game! We will be very grateful!

[b]What's next?[/b]
We will be implementing a rating system in multiplayer.
Add new levels and their sizes.
New buildings.

Good luck and good game!

notes.title: Humble beginnings
notes.content:
We are happy to present you our new Japanese-style project with mind-blowing puzzles! This game is based on the well-known game "Skyscrapers" for puzzle lovers. The release is scheduled for June 30th.

The main idea of the game is as follows:
You have cells and tips on the sides. You need to fill in the cells in such a way that the hints do not contradict them. There are only two rules:
-Numbers cannot be repeated in their row and column.
-Hints say how many buildings (skyscrapers) are visible if you look at this row/column from the side of the hint.
Your task is to completely fill in all the numbers on the game board.

[b]Campaign[/b]
In the campaign, you can go through progressively more difficult levels and bonus levels.

[b]Achievements[/b]
By completing missions in the campaign, you can get achievements. Achievements are also given for multiplayer games and for simple actions.

[b]Leaderboards[/b]
Leader boards are available in some missions. You can set the world record by winning the mission in the shortest time or be the best among your friends!

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
You can compete with other people in solving puzzles for speed. In the future, it is planned to add a rating mode, where you will have a rating and an opponent will be selected for you according to the rating.

[b]Playing with a friend[/b]
You can also create a lobby to play a variety of modes with a friend.

[b]Soundtrack[/b]
Enjoy the game's atmospheric soundtrack in an Asian folk style.
